change: S3b: S3a + batched decode actually enabled (serve.py max_rq_tokens 4096 = page-allocation round, not an output cap, so concurrent jobs start; -ambs 4 -> up to 4 rows per step), VRAM reserve 1.5 GB (1312 cache slots; bsz-4 graph capture OOMed at 1.0)

per_token.per_step_note: per token = per decode step / tokens per step (C2/C4 steps carry 2-4 tokens)

quality.slot_bytecheck: 128 VRAM + 128 RAM, bad 0+0, tables 0; 128 VRAM + 128 RAM, bad 0+0, tables 0
quality.decode_kl_method: same process, CPU lane off (exact GPU path) greedy reference vs forced decode of the same tokens with the CPU lane on (C052i method)

note: batching shares almost no experts across streams (29.6 unique of 32 picks per layer at C4), so C2/C4 gain only the shared non-MoE time; throughput is bound by CPU (0.25 ms/expert effective, native layout) + PCIe admissions (~15 GB/s under CPU DRAM load). Decode KL from the paired run s3_kl2 (same CPU-lane code, C1).
